items.title: Enhance Lighthouse Sponsor Inspection in x402 🚀
items.summary: This update allows the Phantom Lighthouse safety program to reference the sponsored Solana fee payer while maintaining restrictions for other programs. A regression test has been added to ensure that the Lighthouse can inspect account[0] without compromising security. This change addresses a critical production blocker for Solana payments, enhancing transaction safety and functionality.

items.title: Enhance Announcement Webhooks with Localization in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces explicit localization for announcement webhooks, adding support for both Chinese (zh-CN) and English. The changes ensure that English announcements are delivered to Discord and Chinese announcements to WeChat, enhancing user engagement across platforms. Additionally, the update includes a new validation process for translations and improves webhook handling by stopping the indefinite polling of failed tasks.

items.title: Revamp Token Billing with Protocol Awareness in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a comprehensive redesign of token billing by defining four protocol-owned usage families: OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages, and Gemini GenerateContent. Key enhancements include the generation of family-specific JsonLogic catalogs, migration requirements for existing consumers, and the addition of first-class billing profiles and models. The changes aim to improve billing accuracy and streamline usage validation across various API protocols.

items.title: Enhanced Security: Redact Sensitive Payment Logs in Gateway 🔒
items.summary: This update implements comprehensive redaction of sensitive payment information, including Bearer credentials and payment signatures, from logs. Key changes include the removal of raw `/auth` request bodies and enhanced recursive redaction of JSON fields. These improvements ensure that sensitive data is not exposed in logs, bolstering security before the next production validation.

items.title: Enhance Automation Template Wizard in Nexior 🎨
items.summary: This update refines the automation template wizard by making it more compact on desktop and applying the configured primary color for completed steps. Additionally, it improves spacing between various elements like the test-run heading and actions, enhancing overall usability.

items.title: Enhance Codex Tool Handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the handling of Codex computer-use workflows by preserving essential headers and implementing a new credentialed live gate. Key changes include the addition of a contract test for native Responses and the introduction of a three-stage gate to enhance security and functionality. Overall, these enhancements ensure better integration and performance for Codex tools.

items.title: Fix skill slug usage in templates for smoother task creation in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where task creation was rejected due to incorrect skill slugs in scheduled templates. The GitHub project digest and weekly referral blog templates now use namespaced identifiers, ensuring compatibility with the AuthBackend. Additionally, a catalog contract test has been added to verify these changes.

items.title: Launch of New Coding Plan Architecture in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the AceDataCloud Coding Plan subscription architecture, defining three pricing tiers and their respective credit limits. Key changes include a migration to a many-to-many relationship for API services, enabling better reuse of existing APIs and a streamlined purchase lifecycle. The RFC has been added to the plans index, ensuring a clear roadmap for implementation.

items.title: Default New Announcements as Drafts in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: New announcements will now be created as unpublished drafts by default, streamlining the content creation process. This change preserves the existing workflow of saving Chinese drafts, generating English versions, and then publishing. The corresponding server-side rule has been enforced in the PlatformBackend to ensure consistency.

items.title: Enhance announcement mention-all flexibility in Wisdom 🎉
items.summary: This update allows the `mention_all` option in announcements to accept both `true` and `false` values, providing greater flexibility for users. The existing default behavior remains unchanged for callers that do not specify the field, ensuring compatibility with current production payloads. All relevant tests have passed, confirming the stability of the feature.

items.title: Enhance Footer to Reflect Tenant Branding in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update modifies the public footer to display each tenant's site title and copyright instead of the default Ace Data Cloud values. Key changes include the implementation of custom copyright handling and the addition of regression tests for the footer component. The updates ensure that the footer accurately represents the branding of individual tenants, enhancing user experience.

items.title: Enhance Developer Attribution for Public Models in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update replaces the fixed identity prompt with dynamic developer attribution for public model families. It identifies Claude-family models as developed by Anthropic and Kimi models by Moonshot AI, while ensuring internal model details remain protected. All public aliases have been validated to exclude AceDataCloud branding.

items.title: Enhance Chat Contrast for Custom Colors in Nexior 🎨
items.summary: This update separates light and dark brand-tinted surface tokens from the primary palette, ensuring dark chat bubbles remain readable against various site colors. It also introduces WCAG contrast and CSS mapping regression coverage to maintain accessibility standards. The changes have been verified with successful test runs and a browser audit showing excellent contrast ratios.

items.title: Expose DeepSeek V4 Flash Model in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the `deepseek-v4-flash` model to the OpenAI-compatible models endpoint. It ensures that the model is correctly registered and available while maintaining protocol compatibility. Key verification tests confirm the model's presence and absence of any unintended entries.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax Tile Layout in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update allows MiniMax aspect-ratio tiles to wrap within the configuration sidebar, maintaining the existing 48px tile size. The arrangement now displays the options in a balanced 4 + 3 layout on narrow panels. A Beachball patch change file has also been added to support this functionality.

items.title: Exciting New Wallet Payments for Image Scenarios in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a feature-gated wallet payment option for image generation scenarios in Nexior, specifically for Nano Banana and GPT Image 2. Users can now select between Credits and Solana USDC directly from the interface, enhancing payment flexibility. The integration includes a reusable wallet picker and ensures a seamless experience for logged-in users while maintaining privacy for guest users.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax Billing Accuracy in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns the MiniMax billing model with the normalized model value, ensuring accurate cost calculations. Key changes include modifications to the OpenAPI request and cost tests to reflect the correct model and resolution values. Validation confirms that the new setup successfully generates the expected credit amounts.

items.title: Enhance Kling Error Handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update refines the error classification for Kling tasks, designating 'Image format is invalid' as an HTTP 400 error instead of a 500. The changes also relocate the Kling-specific error classifier into the contract module, ensuring its functionality is tested independently of worker infrastructure. These improvements aim to enhance the clarity of error reporting and reduce unnecessary server error alerts.

items.title: Revamp cqtai for MiniMax H3 V2 integration in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update replaces cqtai's legacy handler with a strict MiniMax-H3 contract, enhancing task management and error handling. Key changes include the introduction of a new routing system, improved task object creation, and support for 64 MB request parsing. Additionally, the resolution field is now forwarded to ensure accurate billing, while maintaining synchronous calls until task responses are finalized.

items.title: Update Sass to Latest Version in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps the Sass dependency from version 1.101.0 to 1.102.0. The new version introduces the 2.4 gamma transfer function for rec2020, enhancing color accuracy as per the latest CSS Color 4 draft. This change ensures better compatibility and performance in styling across the platform.

items.title: Enhance Hailuo CLI with MiniMax H3 Features in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the Hailuo CLI with the MiniMax H3 API, introducing new features for video generation and task management. Key changes include support for various media roles, improved task deletion, and batch pagination. Additionally, the documentation and test coverage have been updated to reflect these enhancements.

items.title: Reverting Changes to Fix Proxy2 Requests in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update reverts the recent changes that caused all Proxy2 requests to fail with a `400 model_not_supported` error. The issue arose from incorrect handling of model IDs, which has now been corrected to forward the plain target ID. All tests have passed successfully, restoring functionality while further investigation into the original goal continues.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax MCP with New OpenAPI Features in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the MiniMax MCP with the latest OpenAPI schema, introducing the `MiniMax-H3` model and a structured multimodal `content` payload. Key enhancements include the addition of `minimax_generate_video` for diverse input types, improved task operations like deletion, and refined metadata across documentation and tests. These changes aim to streamline video generation processes and improve user experience.

items.title: Integrate MiniMax H3 V2 Contract in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update implements the official MiniMax H3 V2 contract, enhancing video generation capabilities. Key changes include the adoption of official request and response shapes, validation of aspect ratios, and updates to task cards for improved user feedback. Additionally, all locales have been updated to reflect these changes, ensuring a seamless experience across different languages.

items.title: Official MiniMax H3 V2 Contract Published in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the official MiniMax H3 V2 contract, replacing the previous OpenAPI with a stricter model. Key changes include the publication of task and item responses, updates to billing with the case-sensitive model name, and comprehensive rewrites of guides in both Chinese and English. Compatibility inputs have been removed from public documentation to streamline the API usage.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax H3 V2 Contract Integration in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update implements the official MiniMax H3 V2 contract, ensuring that only approved request fields and content items are accepted. It introduces synchronous handling of task responses and exposes official task objects for various states, while also migrating historical records seamlessly. Comprehensive tests have been added to validate the new functionality.

items.title: Revamp of Dynamic Tenant Support Hub in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update replaces the previous Markdown-based support page with a responsive support hub that pulls directly from site branding data. Key features include tenant-specific contact channels, localized content across 11 languages, and enhanced SEO capabilities. The new design ensures a seamless user experience while maintaining privacy by not exposing platform defaults.

items.title: Enhance Site Menu Actions in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update introduces a dedicated Menus action for each site row on the console, allowing users to deep-link directly to the site's menu settings. The existing Edit and Delete actions remain unchanged, and the action column has been widened to accommodate all controls seamlessly. These enhancements improve user navigation and functionality within the site management interface.

items.title: Enhance Menu Customization Features in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new Menus tab for site management, allowing site owners to customize up to 8 ordered links in both public and console menus. Key changes include the application of `Site.nav` and `Site.console_nav`, options to hide certain console pages, and improved URL safety measures. Additionally, complete translations for 11 locales have been added to enhance accessibility.

items.title: Enhance Console Menu Overrides in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a validated `Site.console_nav` JSON field for signed-in console sidebar overrides, ensuring a clear separation from the public `Site.nav`. It maintains legacy compatibility while enforcing URL safety rules and rejecting unsafe custom links. The backend changes are crucial for enabling immediate console menu editing in conjunction with the upcoming frontend deployment.

items.title: Enhance Proxy2 to Honor Live Context Variants in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves Proxy2 by routing all public aliases through the live context model IDs from the child catalog. It ensures that the requested public alias is preserved in client responses and honors the `[1m]` context for extended targets. All tests have passed successfully, confirming the robustness of these changes.

items.title: Enhance DNS Record Copy Functionality in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update standardizes the copy functionality for DNS records by replacing text-based copy actions with a shared copy icon control. It also streamlines the API curl examples and deployment endpoint fields for both Telegram and Discord. Additionally, duplicate clipboard logic has been removed, and regression tests have been added to ensure the new controls function correctly.

items.title: Revamp Admin Management Features in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update enhances the site administrator management by replacing raw UUID tags with responsive avatar cards that display user names and masked contact details. It introduces a privacy-safe user picker for searching by various identifiers, ensuring no duplicate administrators are added. Additionally, the update maintains immediate save semantics and includes localized guidance across multiple languages.

items.title: Streamline Tenant Experience by Hiding Flagship Features in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update implements the shared `isOurOwnSite` ownership gate to restrict flagship features on tenant sites. Key changes include hiding referral earnings navigation, footer elements, and various service-card entries, along with redirecting specific routes back to the console root. The brand ownership regression suite has been extended to ensure comprehensive coverage, with all tests passing successfully.

items.title: Revamp Pricing Preview for Better Clarity in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update enhances the site pricing preview by repositioning the display-currency helper for improved spacing and replacing the large pricing alert with a more compact status strip. Additionally, source-level regression checks have been added to ensure the integrity of the stacked helper and the new compact preview. These changes aim to streamline the user experience and maintain responsive design across various screen sizes.

items.title: Enhance Branding Typography for Consistency in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update refines the typography across the branding tab by unifying the font sizes to 12px for intro, section descriptions, and field hints. It also normalizes vertical spacing between helper text and form controls, improves toggle-row alignment, and ensures clean wrapping on narrow screens. All changes have passed validation checks, ensuring a consistent user experience.

items.title: Enhance Inactive Account Handling in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a global handling mechanism for inactive accounts, featuring a non-dismissible localized dialog that informs users of account issues. It also clears stale authentication states and redirects users to the login page after acknowledgment. Additionally, the update suppresses duplicate error messages across various flows and includes support for 12 locales, ensuring a smooth user experience.

items.title: Enhance inactive account handling in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a stable `account_inactive` error code for inactive accounts, improving client guidance without needing to parse error messages. The changes include a new exception class and modifications to the authentication user state logic. Additionally, tests have been updated to ensure proper handling of this new error state.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax Video Controls in Nexior 🎥
items.summary: This update aligns the MiniMax video controls with the compact Veo/Kling selector pattern, improving user experience. Key changes include replacing the numeric duration stepper with a standard 4–15 second select and maintaining the Seedance-style segmented resolution control. Visual checks were performed on both desktop and mobile to ensure consistency.

items.title: Enhance Model Identity Handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a dynamic identity instruction for public model aliases, ensuring that responses correctly identify the service as provided through AceDataCloud. Key changes include the enforcement of identity rules that prevent misrepresentation of the service and maintain customer instructions. The implementation has been validated with comprehensive tests, confirming the integrity of the new identity handling.

items.title: Enhance Auth Quarantine Enforcement in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update implements strict checks on user authentication states before creating applications and credentials. Key changes include validating the `is_active` state of users, preventing the creation of stale JWTs, and ensuring that survey rewards are only granted to active users. The system now returns a controlled error response on authentication database failures, enhancing overall security and reliability.

items.title: Harden shared-email abuse quarantine and auth protections in Backend 🔒
items.summary: Added deterministic shared-email abuse detection with account-level quarantine rules and safer restoration ownership checks. Strengthened inactive-user enforcement across login, token refresh, OAuth flows, and SSO exchanges while improving risk pipeline scheduling and failure handling. Expanded validation coverage with adversarial tests and production dry-run verification.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax Uploads and Controls in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update replaces the MiniMax reference image/audio URL textareas with authenticated file uploads and media previews. It aligns various controls with the shared video-scenario field and updates all locales to remove obsolete pricing copy. Additionally, the uploaded previews are now synchronized with the parent state, improving user experience and functionality.

items.title: Update wrangler to latest version in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps the wrangler package from version 4.113.0 to 4.118.0, introducing several minor changes and bug fixes. Key improvements include the addition of a --json flag for consistent output, enabling local observability capture by default, and enhancements to Workflow triggers. These updates aim to improve development efficiency and reliability.

items.title: Automated Deployment for Facilitator in x402 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces automatic deployment for FacilitatorX402 when changes are pushed to the main branch, while retaining manual dispatch options. It ensures production deployments are serialized to prevent overlap and maintains the existing deployment sequence for safety. Additionally, a new workflow contract test has been added to validate triggers and concurrency settings.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax with Resolution Controls in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces new resolution pricing controls for MiniMax, allowing users to select between 768P and 2K options. Additionally, it mandates prompts in all MiniMax modes and includes AIGC watermark controls. The changes have been localized across 17 languages to ensure accessibility for a global audience.

items.title: Enhance SDK with hcaptcha and captcha support in S D K 🚀
items.summary: This update adds missing hcaptcha and captcha endpoints across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, ensuring API surface parity. New resource paths and client wiring have been implemented, along with task endpoint routing synchronization. Comprehensive tests have also been added to validate the new functionality.

items.title: Enhance Admin Diagnostics for Checker Failures in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update ensures that the admin interface always displays diagnostic information for failed checker events, even when no specific error details are available. Key changes include the addition of localized fallback messages for all supported languages and improvements to the diagnostic rendering logic. This enhancement will provide operators with clearer insights into failures, improving overall user experience.

items.title: Enhance Error Diagnostics for OpenAI Checker in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the error handling for the OpenAI checker by ensuring that actionable diagnostics are preserved during failure events. Key changes include enforcing default values for `error_type` and `error_excerpt`, as well as cleaning up stale error fields on successful events. The modifications enhance the clarity of failure reasons provided to the admin console, thereby improving operational transparency.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax with New Resolution and Watermark Features in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces 768P and 2K resolution options along with watermark parameters for all MiniMax MCP generation tools. It mandates prompts in every mode and requires images for audio guidance, ensuring a more robust user experience. Additionally, the exact resolution pricing has been published in the documentation for better transparency.

items.title: Fix normalized resolution billing values in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns Gateway-normalized `768p` and `2k` values in MiniMax billing rules, ensuring accurate pricing. Regression tests have been added to cover the normalized payloads, and the `/price` endpoint now correctly returns 2.40283288 Credits for 768P × 4s. Additionally, a test overcharge has been refunded and ApiUsage corrected.

items.title: Enhance Pricing and Documentation in A P Is 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces detailed documentation for the 768P and 2K request fields, including the exact pricing for the largest package. Key changes include the requirement of a prompt in all modes and the addition of audio/image constraints. These enhancements aim to improve user experience and clarity in API usage.

items.title: Enhance Document Resolution Pricing in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update documents the pricing for 768P and 2K resolutions, along with watermark and required prompt rules. All generation examples have been updated to reflect these changes, ensuring clarity for users. These enhancements aim to improve user experience and understanding of the minimax video generation process.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax with Resolution Pricing Controls in Dify 🎨
items.summary: This update introduces resolution and AIGC watermark controls for MiniMax Dify generation, enhancing user customization. It enforces prompt requirements and image/audio constraints while updating the payloads to be resolution-aware. Additionally, tests and documentation have been updated to reflect these changes.

items.title: Streamline Responses Handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update enhances the github-proxy2 by omitting the `temperature` and `top_p` parameters when bridging to a Responses-only upstream model. It aligns the behavior with the established Responses dialect, improving compatibility and reducing HTTP 400 errors. The changes have been validated with successful test results, ensuring a smoother experience for users.

items.title: Confirmed hcaptcha CLI Parity with Latest Docs in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update verifies that the hcaptcha CLI is in full alignment with the latest OpenAPI documentation. A thorough audit was conducted, confirming that all endpoints and command options match the specifications without any need for code changes. The repository remains unchanged, ensuring stability while maintaining documentation accuracy.

items.title: Enhance GitHub Proxy to Handle Disabled Thinking in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the GitHub proxy to treat `enable_thinking: false` as a no-op when processing requests for Responses-only models. It ensures that requests with `enable_thinking: true` are still rejected to maintain correct reasoning semantics. Focused bridge tests have been added to cover both scenarios, improving the reliability of the service.

items.title: Enhance Captcha Protection in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update implements a robust policy to block captcha token-solving requests targeting `acedata.cloud` and its subdomains. Key changes include the normalization of various URL formats to prevent hostname bypasses and the introduction of a new `PROTECTED_CAPTCHA_DOMAINS` setting. The update ensures a consistent rejection of unauthorized requests across multiple captcha services, enhancing security for all users.

items.title: Update Suno Docs API Sync in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns the Suno OpenAPI by renaming the audio-generation exclusion field from `style_negative` to `negative_tags`. The MCP already forwards this updated field, ensuring no source changes are necessary. Regression tests confirm that the existing coverage effectively handles the new field.

items.title: Enhance CLI Video Options in Clis 🎥
items.summary: This update aligns the `hailuo` CLI with the latest OpenAPI specifications for the `minimax` service. Key changes include the addition of new request options for video generation, such as resolution and watermark settings, along with input constraints for image and audio URLs. The documentation and tests have also been updated to reflect these changes, ensuring a smoother user experience.

items.title: Align MCP Video Tool Schema with Latest Docs in M C Ps 🎥
items.summary: This update synchronizes the `minimax` MCP server schema with the latest OpenAPI documentation, introducing new video-generation request fields while maintaining existing endpoint behavior. Key changes include the addition of `MinimaxResolution` and updates to the video tools to handle new parameters like `resolution` and `aigc_watermark`. The documentation and tests have also been aligned to reflect these enhancements.

items.title: Enhance Codex Model Exposure in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update preserves the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/models` data array while exposing normalized entries as top-level models for Codex model-manager compatibility. It also includes tests to ensure both response fields are covered, improving the integration with VS Code Codex. This change addresses issues with model refresh errors in the Codex extension log.

items.title: Enhance hcaptcha CLI with rqdata support in Clis 🚀
items.summary: The hcaptcha CLI has been updated to support the optional `rqdata` field in token-generation requests. Users can now include `--rqdata TEXT` when using the `hcaptcha token` command, enhancing the flexibility of token requests. Additionally, documentation has been updated to reflect these changes, ensuring users have clear guidance on the new functionality.

items.title: Enhanced MiniMax H3 Pricing for 768P and 2K Outputs in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces resolution-aware pricing for the MiniMax H3 model, specifically for 768P and 2K video outputs. The pricing aligns with the largest-package USD rates, enhancing the billing structure. Additionally, documentation has been updated to reflect these changes, including the model catalog, OpenAPI specifications, and bilingual guides.

items.title: Enhance hCaptcha Token with rqdata Support in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces support for the optional `rqdata` parameter in the hCaptcha token API. The `hcaptcha_get_token` method has been modified to accept this new parameter, which is now included in the API payload. Additionally, the documentation has been updated to reflect this change, and a new test has been added to ensure proper token payload construction.

items.title: Fix custom domain tab rendering issue in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a rendering issue in the custom domain tab by escaping the `@` character in DNS hints using Vue I18n interpolation. The fix ensures that the interpolated host-record marker displays correctly without causing syntax errors. All locales have been updated accordingly, enhancing the user experience across the platform.

items.title: Enhance hCaptcha API with rqdata support in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update exposes the optional `rqdata` field in the `POST /captcha/token/hcaptcha` API for Enterprise challenges, allowing for improved handling of specific captcha scenarios. The change maintains existing functionality for standard hCaptcha requests and includes documentation updates to reflect this new field. Additionally, regression tests have been added to ensure the integrity of the API contract.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax H3 Video Processing in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces MiniMax H3 handling to the ephone worker, enabling support for various video task modes including text, first-frame image, multi-image, and audio-guided formats at 768P and 2K resolutions. A dedicated Kubernetes secret has been implemented, and outputs are now directed to the AceDataCloud CDN. Additionally, isolated contract coverage and production manifests have been added to ensure robust deployment and testing.

items.title: Enhance Wallet Usage Attribution in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new feature allowing signed x402 retries to carry an existing AceDataCloud Credential as an identity-only sidecar. It maintains USDC/x402 as the payment rail while attributing API usage and worker tasks to specific user/application/credential IDs. The actual payer wallet is now stored separately, ensuring a seamless experience for both authenticated and guest users.

items.title: Enhance API Attribution for Auth Errors in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the logging of authentication errors by accurately attributing them to the respective APIs. It resolves the original request path and HTTP method during asynchronous logging, ensuring that registered endpoints are correctly populated while maintaining the raw requested path for unknown routes. The changes are non-blocking, preserving existing authentication responses and billing behavior.

items.title: Enhance hCaptcha Integration in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update connects the hCaptcha feature flag from the server to the AuthFrontend, ensuring that the hCaptcha is rendered correctly across various user flows, including registration and password resets. Key changes include routing API requests to PlatformBackend and implementing a fallback to Turnstile when hCaptcha is disabled. The integration has been validated with successful tests in production environments.

items.title: Stop Unused Probes for Enhanced Coverage in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update halts the Gemini native, Claude chat, and Claude Messages synthetic probes, as customer traffic now ensures adequate production coverage. Other probes remain unchanged, preserving their functionality and performance. The shared production credential for various workloads has also been maintained.

items.title: Enhance Email Signup Limits for Shared Providers in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces separate rate-limit buckets for shared email providers, allowing up to 30 events per hour and 250 events per day while maintaining strict limits for custom domains. The changes also include normalization for shared domains across various registration paths, enhancing the system's ability to manage signups effectively. A production audit revealed significant signup activity from shared domains, prompting these necessary adjustments.

items.title: Enhance Checker Outcome Preservation in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the preservation of grouped checker outcomes by ensuring that representative probe success and TTFT are retained during history event rebuilding. The changes also maintain existing failure behaviors and add regressions for better diagnostics. Validation tests have confirmed that all relevant checks passed successfully.

items.title: Enhance OpenAI Checker Probes for Better Performance in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces an opt-in grouping for shared checker probes, allowing multiple aliases to share a single network probe while maintaining individual performance metrics. Key changes include improved error logging and the transition from WebSocket to HTTP for child Responses transport, enhancing stability and diagnostics. The rollout plan ensures minimal disruption while monitoring for correlated failures.

items.title: Update SMS Signature for Compliance in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update changes the default Tencent SMS signature from '静觅科技' to '北京静觅网络科技' to align with approved standards. The SMS application ID and template handling remain unchanged, ensuring continuity in functionality. Validation tests have passed successfully, confirming the integrity of the changes.

items.title: Update SMS Templates for Compliance in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update replaces outdated SMS templates with approved versions for domestic registration, password reset, and identity verification. The international template remains unchanged, ensuring consistency across user communications. Validation checks confirm no linting errors and proper type checking.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax API Integration in A P Is 🚀
items.summary: This update maps the `minimax/` directory to the new public `AceDataCloud/MiniMaxAPI` repository, ensuring a seamless transition. Additionally, the API README now includes a link to the hosted MiniMax MCP, enhancing accessibility for users. A targeted sub-repo sync has also been triggered to reflect these changes.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax README with API Reference in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update links the MiniMax MCP README to its public API reference, improving accessibility for users. Additionally, it triggers the mapping of the `minimax/` directory into the `AceDataCloud/MinimaxMCP` repository. These changes aim to streamline the integration process for developers.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax MCP Sync Configuration in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update registers the `minimax/` repository in the MCP monorepo mirror map and publishes it to `AceDataCloud/MinimaxMCP`. This change enables standalone CI and deployment processes to run smoothly for MiniMax. The sync configuration has been verified by parsing the `sync.yaml` file and confirming the mapping.

items.title: Align CLI with Latest Minimax API in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the `hailuo` CLI with the latest Minimax OpenAPI specifications, ensuring endpoint and model alignment. Key changes include updated paths for video and task endpoints, a refined model contract, and new request schema options for generating videos. Additionally, tests have been updated to reflect these changes, enhancing overall functionality and reliability.

items.title: Enhance Template Wizard Diagnostics in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the scheduled-template wizard by refining error handling and enhancing user guidance. Key changes include better diagnostics for remote MCP connections, clearer navigation prompts across multiple languages, and improved display of connection statuses. These enhancements aim to streamline the user experience and provide more actionable feedback during template setup.

items.title: Enhance MCP Connection Handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a bug where the AceDataCloud remote MCP connections were incorrectly treated as skill account bindings. Key changes include exposing `execution_type` and `supports_task_binding` in the connection account metadata, ensuring that only skill-backed accounts can be bound while maintaining authorization for remote MCPs. The fix has been validated with production traces and successful TypeScript builds.

items.title: Enhance SVM Payment Verification in x402 🚀
items.summary: This update replaces upstream SVM instruction assumptions with outcome-based verification, ensuring safer payment processing. Key changes include enforcing a single compute limit and price, requiring two signers, and rejecting invalid instructions that reference the fee payer. The modifications enhance security and compliance with the 402 challenge specifications.

items.title: MiniMax MCP Sync Verification Complete in M C Ps 🚀
